sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can report that something doesn't work or broke, using nem működik and elromlott, and say something is missing, using hiányzik.
I can politely ask someone if they could help me, using tudna/tudnál segíteni, and say I need something using szükségem van valamire.
I can make a complaint and explain the problem, using szeretnék reklamálni, and ask about a refund or exchange.
I can talk about the future using fog + infinitive, and book, change, or cancel an appointment.
I can talk about a problem getting solved using megold and megoldódik, and link a problem to what I do next using ezért.
